title: Operational separation of duties and privileges need evidence
remediation: Staff and gate maintainers demonstrate that role restrictions apply during approval, routine work and privileged actions, including a denial when a person holds incompatible roles. The deployment identity and security owners approve the role matrix and sample privilege reviews, separate privileged accounts, and the allowed and denied action audit records.

milestones.title: Demonstrate the signed role and approval transitions including the dual-role self-approval refusal
Verify scope, assignment and revocation of delegated actions where deployed
Reconcile the approved privilege matrix with tested restrictions, review results and audit records
